body.x: The IMC will introduce its big data analysis solution TEXTOM and big data platform TEXTOMi at CES 2020, which will be held in Las Vegas on Jan. 7-10.

TEXTOM is a big data analysis solution that can analyze data anytime and anywhere. Its strength is in real-time large data collection and large data storage. It also enables fast and accurate data processing and purification, production of analysis data by various algorithms, and various types of visualization optimized for the purpose.

TEXTOMi is a big data platform that helps make scientific marketing decisions with the real-time data. It can collect and integrate data in real time, apply data mining and AI (emotional analysis) technology, and then customize the data.
The company official said, "Data andtechnology come from people. The IMC will think of services for people withthat data and technology."

Daegu Metropolitan City has supported 196 ICT venture companies and SMEs in the area to enter the market for eight consecutive years since 2013, with the cumulative contract amount of $22.4 million as of 2019.

Daegu Joint Pavilion, organized by Daegu Technopark Mobile Convergence Center, will have 44 ICT convergence ventures and SMEs and three startups. Major programs include exhibitions, investor pitching, public relations with foreign media, and post-CES review conferences. In CES 2019, Daegu and Gyeongbuk Province exchanged MOU to run joint pavilion in CES for the benefits of both parties, and the joint pavilion has been set up in CES 2020. The world’s largest IT show CES shows the trend of the global technology issues and trends at a glance. It is hosted by Consumer Technology Association (CTA) and is held every January.
